app.name: Logic Quest
app.tagline: Train Your Brain. Challenge Your Logic.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

sequence.name: Number Sequences
sequence.desc: Find the rule behind a row of numbers.
sequence.howTo: Each sequence follows one hidden rule. Find it, then enter the missing number. Every answer comes with the exact calculation.

pattern.name: Pattern Recognition
pattern.desc: Shapes, colors, rotations, grids and symmetry.
pattern.howTo: Look at one property at a time (shape, color, rotation, number, fill) and pick the tile that completes the pattern.

deduction.name: Logical Deduction
deduction.desc: Orderings, clues, truth-tellers and code locks.
deduction.howTo: Read every clue carefully. Each puzzle has exactly one solution, proven by our solver, and the explanation shows why.

memory.name: Memory Challenge
memory.desc: Sequences, lit cells, numbers and symbols.
memory.howTo: Tap Start when you are ready, memorize what appears, then reproduce it. You can turn on relaxed timing in Settings.

welcome.title: Train your brain
welcome.body: Original logic puzzles in short sessions. A few minutes a day keeps your mind sharp.

modes.title: Four kinds of challenges
modes.body: Number sequences, visual patterns, logical deduction and memory, from easy to truly hard.

explained.title: Every answer explained
explained.body: After each puzzle you see why the answer is right. Works fully offline, with no account.

setup.title: Let's set things up
setup.easyBody: Start with easy puzzles. Harder ones unlock as you solve.
setup.mediumBody: Medium difficulty is unlocked right away.
setup.privacy: Your progress stays on your device. You can change these choices at any time in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.premiumHint: Hard puzzles, unlimited hints, no ads.
settings.relaxedTimingDesc: Memory challenges stay on screen 50% longer.
settings.reminderDesc: One notification a day for the daily challenge.
settings.reminderDenied: Notifications are blocked. You can allow them in your phone settings.
settings.analyticsDesc: Helps improve the game. No name, email or contacts, ever.

data.title: Your data
data.intro: Your progress is stored only on this device. Export it to keep a backup or to move to a new phone.
data.exportDesc: Creates a JSON file you can save or share.
data.importDesc: Replaces the progress on this device with a backup file.
data.importConfirmBody: Your current progress on this device will be replaced by the backup.
data.importInvalid: This file is not a Logic Quest backup.
data.importNewer: This backup comes from a newer version of the app. Please update Logic Quest first.
data.deleteDesc: Erases your progress, statistics, achievements and settings on this device. Purchases stay linked to your Google account.
data.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you want to keep your progress.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Logic Quest is designed to work without collecting personal data.
privacy.storageBody: Your games, progress, statistics and settings are stored only on your phone. There is no Logic Quest server.
privacy.accountBody: You never need to sign up or give your name or email address.
privacy.analyticsBody: Only if you agree, anonymous usage events (such as "game completed") help us improve the game. You can turn this off at any time.
privacy.adsBody: The free version shows ads from Google AdMob. Where the law requires it, you are asked for consent first. Premium removes all ads.
privacy.purchasesBody: Payments are handled by Google Play. We never see your payment details.
privacy.rightsBody: Export or delete all your data at any time from Settings.

notifications.reminderBody: A new Logic Quest challenge is waiting. Can you solve it?
